title: AAHub role lookup table (hand-authored)
description: Each entry is written by hand after opening the native-scale PNG crop of one region together with its exact TXT rows (trueff-shallot AGENTS.md inspection rule, 2026-10-27). Entries decide construction; corpus frequencies (aahub_blocks.v1) may only rank or validate them. A file is either a merged table (entries + taxonomy) or one source group's entry file.

role_extensions.description: Roles a source demanded that are not in the base taxonomy: name -> one-line definition.

role.description: Base taxonomy name or a declared role_extensions name.

also_roles.description: Other roles the same rows demonstrate.

band.description: xs: 1 row; s: 2-3 rows; m: 4-6 rows; l: 7+ rows

tangent_in.description: Screen direction the stroke arrives from, travelling left-to-right / top-to-bottom along the feature.

curvature.description: Sign relative to the inside of the form.

inside.description: Which side of the mark is the form's inside.

paper.description: Where protected paper/negative space sits and must stay empty.

rows.description: Verbatim slices: every glyph (U+3000 / U+0020 spaces included) whose pen lies in x_px, per source row.

x_px.description: Pen-x range [x0, x1) in px from line start, Saitamaar 16 px.

row_pen_x.description: Absolute pen x of each slice's first glyph (null for an empty slice); subtract x_px[0] for offsets.

ports.description: Role (or 'paper') each side connects to in the source drawing; null = drawing edge / nothing.

src.description: role_crop.py SRC spec, repo-relative path: txt:<path> | mlt:<path.json.gz>#<aa index> | lib:<library-id>#<aa index>

label.description: Human locator: page / aa[index] / resK name / catalog section.

cited_by.description: Skill/reference/annotation that cites this source (e.g. structural-line-selection.md 'Cooperating joins'; swipe audit T #14 r4).

note.description: One line: why this is a good (or instructive bad) example.

operator_note.description: Verbatim operator label/note text that decides the state, when one exists.

inspection.description: The AGENTS.md step-3 line: glyphs, rows and relationship actually observed in the crop+TXT.
